game.name: Sonic the Hedgehog (2006)
game.rules:
# General rules

All full-game runs **require** video proof.

All Individual Level runs that are World Record claims also **require** video proof. Other level runs must have at the very least a **screenshot with the results screen displayed with the rank, final time, and background visible**. Video submissions for runs that are not WR are still very much recommended, but are not the only way to submit.

All runs must be done on an unmodified copy of the game. You are permitted to change music tracks on Emulator. 

All game files, including save data, must be preserved and unmodified.

# Methods of play

Runs must be done on an unmodded Xbox 360.

You are permitted to install custom firmware on a PlayStation 3 for the express purpose of installing the game onto your Hard Disk Drive. You are permitted to swap this out with an SSD for faster loads.

## Emulator rules

You must use a compatible version of **Xenia** to submit runs on emulator. Any other emulators, including RPCS3 are **not** permitted currently.

For full-game runs, you must use the LiveSplit autosplitter to calculate your game time.

# Full-game information

Console runs above a certain threshold are timed in **RTA (Time with loads)** whereas emulator runs are additionally timed in **LRT (Load-removed time)** using LiveSplit IGT.

Once you have met this threshold, you will be eligible to receive an **LRT (Load-removed time)** retiming for your run. Submit your run, or send the recording to the moderators and we will manually retime your run. 

Make sure to check the category rules to see the threshold for loadless retiming in each category!

values.name: Any%
values.rules:
# Objective

Reach the credits of Sonic's Story as fast as possible.

# Timing 

Timing starts when you select Sonic in Episode Select.

Timing ends when the "Now Loading" Arrow disappears from the bottom of the screen

# Loadless threshold

Runs under **15 minutes** RTA are eligible for Loadless retiming.

values.name: No Credits Warp
values.rules:
# Objective

Complete Sonic's Story as fast as possible.

# Restrictions

You are not permitted to use any method of warping to the credits. 

Mission Select Glitch, as long as it is not used to warp to the credits, is permitted.

# Timing 

Timing starts when you select Sonic in Episode Select.

Timing ends when the level timer freezes in Egg-Wyvern. 

# Loadless threshold

Runs under **1 hour 3 minutes** RTA are eligible for Loadless retiming.

values.name: No Major Glitches
values.rules:
# Objective

Complete Sonic's Story as fast as possible whilst not performing any major glitches.

# NMG Restrictions

**NOTE: A full list of banned tricks can be found [here](https://www.speedrun.com/sonic06/guides/4synn) in the Guides section.**

1) You may not skip any required story missions or act stages
2) You may not skip the results screen
3) You may not clip through any asset or geometry
4) You may not gain unreasonable height by way of spinkicking objects
5) You may not damage a boss except through its exposed weak points
6) You may not go above the speed cap through abuse of stage geometry
7) You may not abuse the homing attack by intentionally missing your lock-on target
8) You may not use the sky gem to interrupt an automation section

# Timing 

Timing starts when you select Sonic in Episode Select.

Timing ends when the level timer freezes in Egg-Wyvern.

# Loadless threshold

Loadless retiming is currently not applicable for No Major Glitches.

values.name: All Gold Medals
values.rules:
# Objective

Collect all the gold medals in Sonic's Story as fast as possible.

# Restrictions

You must check the "Gold Medal Results" screen once you complete your run to verify you have collected all 61 gold medals.

# Timing 

Timing starts when you select Sonic in Episode Select.

Timing ends on clearing the final save prompt after collecting the final gold medal.

# Loadless threshold

Loadless retiming is currently not applicable for All Gold Medals.

values.name: No Gems
values.rules: Use of any of Sonic's custom actions, including the red, blue, green, purple, sky, white and yellow gems, is disallowed in this category.

values.name: Story Style
values.rules:
Only use the upgrades available to you at the point of the story where you would normally play the stage.

Red Gem is banned.

Death/Checkpoint abuse (such as abusing the Radical Train train cycles) is banned. 

You can take S ranks.

Any run on the other boards that qualify for Story Style can be copied over to these boards. (Except Dusty Desert, Tropical Jungle, and Wave Ocean: Tails, those will stay under the "Normal" boards.)

The boss fights will stay under the "Normal" or "No Gems" boards, the only exception being Egg Wyvern, if you did it without the use of the Red Gem.

Timing starts when you select Last Story in Episode Select. You must have 0% progress in Last Story and must start with 0 silver/gold medals collected.

Timing ends on clearing the final save prompt after collecting the final gold medal.

# Loadless threshold

Loadless retiming is currently not applicable for All Gold Medals.

values.name: No Gems
values.rules: Use of any of Sonic's custom actions, including the red, blue, green, purple, sky, white and yellow gems, is disallowed in this category.

values.name: No Major Glitches
values.rules:
# Objective

Complete Shadow's Story as fast as possible whilst not performing any major glitches.

# NMG Restrictions

**NOTE: A full list of banned tricks can be found [here](https://www.speedrun.com/sonic06/guides/4synn) in the Guides section.**

1) You may not skip any required story missions and stages
2) You may not skip the results screen
3) You may not clip through any asset or geometry
4) You may not gain unreasonable height by way of spinkicking objects
5) You may not damage a boss except through its exposed weak points
6) You may not use Chaos Snap to teleport through solid surfaces
7) You may not abuse the chaos snap by intentionally missing your lock-on target
8) You may not gain unreasonable height by use of frame perfect inputs when flying with Rouge and/or Omega
9) You may not exit out of vehicles in the following sections (Full list in 'Guides')
10) You may not pass through killplanes by exiting and entering a vehicle

# Timing 

Timing starts when you select Shadow in Episode Select. You must have 0% progress on Shadow's Story.

Timing ends when the level timer freezes in Mephiles Phase 2.

# Loadless threshold

Loadless retiming is currently not applicable for No Major Glitches.

values.name: Story Style
values.rules:
Only use the upgrades available to you at the point of the story where you would normally play the stage.

Red Gem is banned.

Death/Checkpoint abuse (such as abusing the Radical Train train cycles) is banned. 

You can take S ranks.

Any run on the other boards that qualify for Story Style can be copied over to these boards. (Except Dusty Desert, Tropical Jungle, and Wave Ocean: Tails, those will stay under the "Normal" boards.)

The boss fights will stay under the "Normal" or "No Gems" boards, the only exception being Egg Wyvern, if you did it without the use of the Red Gem.
